The Wicked Queen () is an upcoming South Korean television series starring Park Eun-bin. Based on web novel of the same name by Yoon Tae-roo, the series is set in the Eon Dynasty's imperial court, it depicts the romance between Hyunbi Gae-ri and the cold Emperor Eon.
Synopsis
Cast
* Park Eun-bin as Hyunbi Gae-ri
* Kim Jae-won as Emperor Eon
Production
In March 2026, Park Eun-bin was reportedly considering the female lead, Hyunbi Gae-ri. The next month, Kim Jae-won received an offer for the male lead, Emperor Eon.
